headword: {緊急警報|きんきゅうけいほう}

definitions.explanation: An urgent notification issued to warn the public of imminent danger such as earthquakes, tsunamis, severe weather, or other emergencies.

examples.japanese: {緊急警報|きんきゅうけいほう}が{鳴|な}った。
スマートフォンに{緊急警報|きんきゅうけいほう}が{届|とど}いた。
examples.english: An emergency alert arrived on my smartphone.

examples.japanese: {大雨|おおあめ}による{土砂災害|どしゃさいがい}の{危険|きけん}があるため、{緊急警報|きんきゅうけいほう}が{発令|はつれい}された。
examples.english: An emergency warning was issued due to the risk of landslides caused by heavy rain.

notes:
A compound of {緊急|きんきゅう} (emergency; urgent) and {警報|けいほう} (warning; alarm). In Japan, the {緊急警報放送|きんきゅうけいほうほうそう} (Emergency Warning Broadcast System) and {緊急地震速報|きんきゅうじしんそくほう} (Earthquake Early Warning) are well-known systems that send alerts via television, radio, and smartphones.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {緊急警報|きんきゅうけいほう}が{鳴|な}る: an emergency alert sounds
- {緊急警報|きんきゅうけいほう}が{発令|はつれい}される: an emergency warning is issued
- {緊急警報|きんきゅうけいほう}を{受|う}ける: to receive an emergency alert
- {緊急警報|きんきゅうけいほう}{放送|ほうそう}: Emergency Warning Broadcast

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {警報|けいほう}: warning; alarm — the general term for any official warning, not necessarily urgent
- {緊急地震速報|きんきゅうじしんそくほう}: Earthquake Early Warning — a specific system that alerts people seconds before shaking arrives
- {避難警報|ひなんけいほう}: evacuation warning — specifically instructs people to evacuate
